component.name: CapabilityValidator
component.script:
sub init() m.primaryVideo = m.top.findNode("primaryVideo") m.standbyVideo = m.top.findNode("standbyVideo") m.validationTimer = m.top.findNode("validationTimer") m.validationPhase = "" m.capabilityRecorded = false
m.top.observeField("validationRequested", "validateCapabilities") m.primaryVideo.observeField("state", "onPrimaryVideoState") m.standbyVideo.observeField("state", "onStandbyVideoState") m.validationTimer.observeField("fire", "onValidationTimeout") end sub
sub validateCapabilities() if m.validationPhase <> "" then return m.needsValidation = not hasDualVideoPrebufferSupportSetting() mode = LCase(m.top.startupVideoMode.trim()) if mode <> "always" then mode = "firstrun" m.showIntro = mode = "always" or m.needsValidation
if not m.showIntro and not m.needsValidation finishValidation() return end if if m.top.startupVideoUrl.trim() = "" if m.needsValidation then recordCapability(false) finishValidation() return end if
content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = m.top.startupVideoUrl.trim() content.streamFormat = streamFormatFromUrl(content.url)
m.validationPhase = "starting" m.primaryVideo.loop = m.needsValidation m.primaryVideo.visible = m.showIntro m.primaryVideo.content = content m.validationTimer.duration = 10 m.validationTimer.control = "start" m.primaryVideo.control = "play" end sub
sub onPrimaryVideoState(event as object) if m.validationPhase = "" then return state = event.getData() if state = "error" if m.needsValidation then recordCapability(false) finishValidation() else if state = "playing" and m.validationPhase = "starting" m.validationTimer.control = "stop" if m.needsValidation m.validationPhase = "prebuffering" m.standbyVideo.content = m.primaryVideo.content m.validationTimer.duration = 5 m.validationTimer.control = "start" m.standbyVideo.control = "prebuffer" else waitForIntro() end if else if state = "finished" finishValidation() end if end sub
sub onStandbyVideoState(event as object) if m.validationPhase <> "prebuffering" then return if event.getData() = "error" recordCapability(false) stopStandbyVideo() continueIntro() end if end sub
sub onValidationTimeout() if m.validationPhase = "prebuffering" recordCapability(true) stopStandbyVideo() continueIntro() else if m.validationPhase = "starting" if m.needsValidation then recordCapability(false) finishValidation() else finishValidation() end if end sub
sub recordCapability(supported as boolean) if m.capabilityRecorded then return saveDualVideoPrebufferSupport(supported) m.capabilityRecorded = true end sub
sub waitForIntro() m.validationPhase = "intro" m.validationTimer.control = "stop" m.validationTimer.duration = 60 m.validationTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub continueIntro() m.primaryVideo.loop = false if m.primaryVideo.state = "finished" finishValidation() else waitForIntro() end if end sub
function streamFormatFromUrl(url as string) as string cleanUrl = url queryAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(fragmentAt - 1) for index = len(cleanUrl) to 1 step -1 character = cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) if character = "." then return LCase(cleanUrl.mid(index)) if character = "/" then exit for end for return "mp4" end function
sub stopStandbyVideo() m.standbyVideo.control = "stop" m.standbyVideo.content = invalid end sub
sub finishValidation() m.validationTimer.control = "stop" m.primaryVideo.control = "stop" stopStandbyVideo() m.primaryVideo.content = invalid m.primaryVideo.loop = false m.primaryVideo.visible = false m.validationPhase = "complete" m.top.complete = true end sub
